Treatment summary
Patient presented following a low-speed collision in a parking lot with ongoing right shoulder pain and reduced range
of motion. Over the course of 18 visits, care consisted of physical therapy, home exercise instruction, and as-needed
anti-inflammatory medication. Treatment followed an expected progression, with visit frequency tapering as
symptoms improved and function returned toward baseline. Examination findings were mixed: several provocative
maneuvers and range-of-motion measurements support a shoulder soft tissue injury, while strength testing and
neurological screening were within normal limits. The patient reports no prior injury or treatment involving this
shoulder. Billed services reflect the planned course of care with no duplicate or repeated charges. At this time it
remains unclear to what extent the present complaints are attributable to the collision versus other causes, and
further imaging correlation may be helpful for that determination. Continued home exercise and reassessment are
recommended, with return precautions reviewed.

injury. Do not list the date of a note, letter, report, visit, statement, filing or signature.

it is the loss date. Examples: "Date of loss:", "Crash date:", "Date of injury:", "the collision on".
